'''Reaction abilities''' {{J|リアクションアビリティ|Riakushon Abiritei}} are abilities that require a trigger to be activated, and once activated, their effects take place.

==Appearances==
===''[[Final Fantasy Tactics]]''===

{{main|Final Fantasy Tactics reaction abilities}}
Reaction abilities activate when their trigger condition is met, and the chance for activating also depends on the user's [[Bravery (Tactics)|bravery]] stat in percentage, the braver the higher chance.

===''[[Final Fantasy Tactics Advance]]''===
{{main|Final Fantasy Tactics Advance reaction abilities}}
Reaction abilities activate when their trigger condition is met. Unlike its predecessor, the reaction abilities varies, ranging from retaliating actions to bestowing positive status.
